dial.summary: BTC holds ~$82K with near-zero funding (0.0036% per 8h) confirming spot-driven accumulation; BTC.D stable in the 57–59% range (no sustained alt rotation); Global M2 still expanding at $103.7T (Aug); headwinds persist — DXY 101.79 (above 100 threshold), real yields 2.84% (well above 2%) — with FOMC Oct 28 the dominant near-term catalyst where a 25bp hike to 4.00–4.25% appears likely given back-to-back CPI/PPI shocks; dial stays BTC Accumulation until BTC.D breaks below 55% on a sustained basis.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.66T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; 4-week trend UP: July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6, up 5.7% YoY, 28th consecutive monthly increase); no September G4 aggregate yet (6–8 week reporting lag); status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); October PMI not yet available — Polymarket implies most-likely October reading in the 52.0–52.9 range; next ISM release November 2, 2026; status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~101.79 (Oct 16, 2026 close per Trading Economics) — continuing pullback from 52-week high of 102.95 on Oct 14 (post-CPI surge); DXY fell further Oct 16 despite hot September PPI (6.3% YoY released Oct 15), suggesting near-term exhaustion after the two-day inflation shock spike; 4-week trend UP from ~99.90 on Sep 15 to 101.79 (+1.9%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 28 decision is the next major catalyst.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.84% as of October 14, 2026 (latest FRED data; down from cycle high of 2.95% on Oct 5 and 2.88% on Oct 13); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 14 to 2.84% (+32bps); US 10yr nominal dipped to ~5.10% on Oct 17 (from 5.19% on Oct 14), which may ease real yields slightly, but FRED DFII10 confirmation for Oct 15–17 not yet available; status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and well above 2% threshold).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 17, 2026: US 10yr ~5.10%, 2yr ~4.77% (per 247Wall St / Treasury par yields) → 2s10s spread ~+33bps; 4-week trend DOWN (Sep 15 ~+42bps → Oct 17 +33bps = −9bps flattening); status neutral — curve remains positively sloped (not a headwind) but is flattening (not supportive); expected FOMC Oct 28 25bp hike would push front end higher and compress the spread further; next major curve catalyst is the Oct 28 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,755,639M ($6.756T) for week ending October 14, 2026 (H.4.1 released Oct 15, 2026; prior week Oct 7 = $6,747,560M, +$8,079M WoW); 4-week trend flat: Sep 16 $6,746,548M → Oct 14 $6,755,639M = +$9,091M (+0.13%); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau — Reserve Management Purchases offsetting MBS runoff); next H.4.1 release October 22, 2026 (covers week ending Oct 21).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0036% as of October 16, 2026 (CoinGlass data); Binance BTC perp funding briefly turned negative to −0.0073% on Oct 15–16 following the CPI/PPI inflation shocks (bearish tilt on that venue); 30-day trend DOWN from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to ~0.0036% on Oct 16; BTC holding near $82K with open interest ~$7.76B (up 3.7% in 24h); status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold — spot-driven, not speculative leverage).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$303–306B (Stablecoin Beat Oct 15 / CoinGecko) vs total crypto ~$2.84T (Coingabbar, CoinGecko data 1:30 AM UTC Oct 17) → dominance ~10.7%; BTC.D at ~57.7% (Coingabbar) to 58.9% (Gate.io), up from 57.5% low on Oct 16 as BTC reclaimed ground; 30-day trend up (Sep 17 est. ~10.5% → Oct 17 ~10.7%); status neutral (rising stablecoin dom but TOTAL market cap is flat/slightly down — the headwind condition requires both rising simultaneously; BTC.D not sustaining below 55% for Alt Rotation flip).

upcoming.title: Housing Starts & Building Permits (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases September 2026 Housing Starts and Building Permits at 8:30 AM ET; with real yields at 2.84% and mortgage rates elevated, continued monthly declines would underscore the drag from high financing costs on residential investment; provides incremental Q3 data ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 18, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 18, 2026 — one of the last major labor data points before the October 28 FOMC decision; a sustained trend above 220K would raise recession risk; carries outsized weight given the September NFP of +29K, hot CPI (3.7% YoY), and hot PPI (6.3% YoY) backdrop heading into the meeting.

upcoming.title: S&P Global US Flash PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases preliminary October 2026 Manufacturing and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET — first Q4 activity data point, released four days before the FOMC meeting begins; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% sets a high bar; a flash manufacturing print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce Fed hold expectations despite hot inflation.
